source: Recorded by scripts/record_sample_fixtures.py, which calls the local NautilusTrader BacktestEngine through sidecar/backtest.py on the bundled synthetic bars. These fixtures are saved output. The TypeScript UI replays them when the sidecar is unavailable. It is not a reimplementation of the Rust engine.
assumptions: Long-only EMA cross on daily sample bars. A cross up buys about 95% of cash at the bar close via a simulated market order. A reduce-only trailing-stop-market (basis points) manages the exit, and a cross down closes the position. Venue id is SIM. Taker fee is 4 bps. Starting equity is 10000 quote units. Sharpe is the mean of daily equity changes divided by their sample standard deviation, times sqrt(365), with a risk-free rate of 0. Figures are sample research output, not live performance or advice.
